title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Application Close Work Item
summary: Add a server-side tunnel context helper that writes application-selected WebSocket close frames and completes writes on accepted RFC 9220 tunnels.
planned_changes:
- Add close-payload formatting and validation beside the close payload parser.
- Add `Http3WebSocketTunnelContext.CloseAsync` to write an unmasked close frame with a selected status/reason and complete writes.
- Add parser/formatter tests for close payload formatting, invalid reason-without-status input, and invalid formatted status codes.
- Add a loopback HTTP/3 server test that sends a masked text message, has the handler close with status 1003 and reason `unsupported`, and verifies the client receives the close frame and stream FIN.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server WebSocket close tests, adjacent ping/close/handler regression tests, the RFC 9220 WebSocket parser tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Automatic close-code mapping for handler exceptions.
QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: The accepted tunnel context can now write explicit application close frames and complete the writable side of the stream.
